title: From Hamilton Hobbiton Waitomo Caves Small Group Tour
blurb:
Discover the magic of Middle-earth with a small group tour from Hamilton to the Hobbiton Movie Set and Waitomo Glowworm Caves. Start your adventure with stunning views of the Waikato region before delving into the enchanting underground world of Waitomo, where bioluminescent glowworms illuminate the caves. After a guided tour, enjoy a visit to the iconic Hobbiton Movie Set, exploring charming hobbit holes and vibrant gardens. Complete your day with a complimentary beverage at the Green Dragon Inn, all while enjoying personalized insights from expert guides.

- Full-day small group tour with a maximum of 16 participants
- Guided tours of both Hobbiton and Waitomo Glowworm Caves
- Scenic drive through the picturesque Waikato region
- Includes a complimentary drink at the Green Dragon Inn
